//site: The IISM Gulmarg pages to watch. All three carry the same site-wide popup (the 'Bookings will open ...' banner + 'Courses opening' table); home also has the 'Latest updates' ticker, Courses_By_IISM has the per-course sections (and last season's snow-skiing table, commented out). applyUrl is the admission portal (mobile-OTP gated, so we only link to it).
//match: A visible line counts as ski news if it matches skiPattern after everything matching ignorePattern is blanked out. ignorePattern drops water skiing; skiPattern deliberately does NOT match the institute's own name ('Institute of Skiing & Mountaineering').
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//dailyHour: Send one quiet (min priority) check-in push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose). It is the proof-of-life heartbeat. -1 disables.
notify.//reminderMinutesBefore: When a booking date/time is announced (popup banner, or a new ski section), push urgent reminders this many minutes before it. 0 = 'bookings are open now'.
notify.//failureAlertHours: If every check fails for this long, push one warning (reset on the next good check).

//watch: Used only in --watch mode. intervalMinutes between checks; booking reminders wake the loop early on their own. jitterSeconds randomizes timing a little so it does not look robotic.
